content.thinking: זו קרן השתלמות: אפשר למשוך בלי מס אחרי 6 שנים, המעסיק משלם 7.5% והעובד 2.5%, והתקרה הנראית היא 15,712 ₪.
The chart shows about 66,513 ₪ left in hand after a 13,974 ₪ tax hit at a 5-year withdrawal, but the bars also say tax is waived from 6 years, so I'll look at waiting until then.
ההערה על העמלה (0.54%) נראית זניחה ולכן אדלג עליה, ואז אבדוק את הספירה מחדש: המשיכה מאפסת את השנים, והמספרים 66,601 ו-66,280 חוזרים על עצמם.

content.text:
"משיכה ומעבר": "עד 4 ימי עסקים". So once I ask, the money comes fast.
"כמה זה עולה": "עד 2% בשנה". Small percent. Fine. I've got what I came for, so I'm closing it.

input.answer: If I earn about 12,000 gross and put in 300 ₪ a month (the boss puts in 900), after 5 years I'd have about 66,500 ₪ in hand. That's after about 14,000 ₪ tax. From 6 years it's tax-free, so I'd wait the 6 years, but I never saw the number for 6.

stuck.where: Calculator chart, 'מושכים את הכסף אחרי 5 שנים'
stuck.why: The page says no tax after 6 years, but the chart opens on 5 years with a red tax bar. So the big number it shows is the taxed one, and there's no number for 6 years.
I only know my take-home, 9,500, not my gross. So I left 12,000 and don't know if it's close to my real salary.
